instruction: Candid full shot at eye-level inside an indoor gym with large windows. In the foreground, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) is seen from behind with his legs spread wide, blocking a kick. Facing him, the young man in the white t-shirt (R1) stands on his left leg, holding his right leg up mid-kick. Both wear protective eyewear and focus on their sparring positions. In the background, a few blurred bystanders watch from the side. Bright daylight from the windows illuminates the scene, creating soft reflections on the floor.
